journal_fit.rationale: The cross-scale manuscript has distinct linked inferential components (discovery, prospective replication, regional scale transfer), matching Ecology's Article description more naturally than the concise single-topic Report format.

primary_evidence_order: Palmer Adelie discovery of concentration during decline
prospectively frozen Signy Adelie external replication
prospectively frozen Signy chinstrap cross-species replication
bounded MAPPPD regional extension interpreted as declining-subset recurrence plus increasing-network boundary
claim_boundary: Replicated non-proportional concentration during decline within Palmer/Signy breeding systems; at regional scale concentration is not unique to decline because all three increasing MAPPPD networks also end with lower E. No universal kappa, trend-independent law, hysteresis, or single mechanism.
freeze_rules: No new ecological endpoint or same-data rescue analysis may be added before initial submission.
No post-result multiplicity rule may be introduced for the four regional declining panels.
MAPPPD is a scale-transfer test, not an additional independent geographic replication of Palmer.
Local and regional p-values and effect sizes must not be pooled.
The local approximately 0.25 kappa estimate must not be described as a universal scaling exponent.
N_eff/E must not be described as genetic Ne or Nb.
Author-controlled metadata remain private until confirmed.
The three increasing MAPPPD panels must remain in the main interpretation and cannot be demoted to appendix-only context.
Do not describe the regional extension as confirmation that decline causes concentration.
